mcqs.q: In November 2026, the Asian Development Bank approved a $500 million loan to support which sector in Pakistan?
mcqs.explanation: The ADB approved a $500 million results-based loan to help Pakistan reform its federal civil pension system to contain fiscal pressures. (Dawn)

mcqs.q: As of November 2026, in how many phases will the local government elections in Punjab be conducted?
mcqs.explanation: The Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) decided that local government polls in Punjab, scheduled for February 2027, will be held in two phases. (Dawn)

mcqs.q: Which country recently announced sanctions against eight Israeli firms involved in West Bank settlement construction?
mcqs.explanation: Britain announced sanctions against eight Israeli construction and property development firms to help halt settlement expansion in the West Bank. (Dawn)

mcqs.q: What is the primary objective of the licensing framework finalized by the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) in November 2026?
options: Providing internet services on high-speed trains
mcqs.explanation: The PTA finalised a framework to allow satellite-based telecommunication services aboard aircraft to provide internet and digital connectivity to passengers. (Dawn)

mcqs.q: What specific action did the Islamabad government take in November 2026 to curb smog and air pollution?
options: Banning all private vehicle movement on weekends
Barring vehicles without fitness and emission testing from entering the capital
Closing all industrial units within city limits
Implementing a mandatory electric vehicle switch for public transport
mcqs.explanation: The government decided to stop vehicles lacking valid fitness and emission testing from entering Islamabad to control smog levels. (Dawn)

mcqs.q: Following the first Test of the 2025-27 World Test Championship cycle, how many points were deducted from the Pakistan team due to slow over-rates?
mcqs.explanation: Pakistan was penalised five points and fined 25 percent of match fees for being five overs short of the required rate during the drawn first Test. (Dawn)

mcqs.q: Which Pakistani city's bus stand saw its annual income increase from Rs25 million to Rs140 million following RTA reforms?
mcqs.explanation: The RTA Rawalpindi increased the revenue of the Pirwadhai General Bus Stand by closing illegal stands and consolidating operations. (Dawn)

mcqs.q: Which Pakistani official attended the 6th Session of the Pakistan–Turkmenistan Joint Intergovernmental Commission (JIC) in Islamabad?
mcqs.explanation: Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar led discussions on the TAPI gas pipeline at the JIC session in Islamabad. (Dawn)

mcqs.q: In November 2026, Peshawar police equipped clerical staff at police stations with body-worn cameras to connect to whose office?
mcqs.explanation: Peshawar police initiated a system where body cameras on muharrars are connected directly to the CCPO office to ensure transparency and oversight. (The Express Tribune)

mcqs.q: What was the official reason for the resignation of Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang, as reported in November 2026?
options: Allegations regarding an affair with a suspected Chinese spy
Disagreements with the company board over AI strategy
mcqs.explanation: Jensen Huang resigned after revelations of an affair with a woman suspected of having ties to Chinese espionage efforts. (Dawn/AFP)
